mechanism: Minocycline may increase carvedilol levels through CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 inhibition, and both drugs have potential photosensitivity effects; additionally, tetracyclines can cause intracranial hypertension which may complicate cardiovascular management.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative antibiotic if feasible or adjust carvedilol dosing if hypotension/bradycardia develops; counsel patient on photosensitivity precautions.
